field_definitions.supported_conflict: Manual semantic judgment that the source claims support an actual conflict, irrespective of the answer’s chosen classification.
field_definitions.correctly_surfaced_conflicts: Gold label is conflict AND parsed final classification is conflict AND supported_conflict is true AND citation_error is false. This is the conflict success count; supported_conflict alone is not a success measure.
field_definitions.semantic_citation_errors: Manual audit findings among rows with completed status; source-ID mismatch and non-exact quoted text count. Malformed/absent answers are accounted separately in run output quality.
field_definitions.evaluator_classification_correct: The deterministic evaluation score’s classification_correct field; it is reported separately from manual semantic judgments.
field_definitions.planned_rows: Fixed planned denominator from the frozen design: 60 per arm, 20 per gold label. Aborted and not-run rows count as incorrect/not surfaced for full-denominator rates.
field_definitions.reviewed_completed_rows: Rows whose status is completed and which received manual annotations; this excludes aborted/not-run rows.
field_definitions.parsed_final_rows: Completed rows with a parseable final answer; malformed finals remain in the completed denominator and score as incorrect.

aggregate_notes.classification_accuracy_denominator: Report both completed-row counts and accuracy over the fixed planned denominator of 60 per arm; do not drop malformed, aborted, or not-run rows from the headline denominator.
aggregate_notes.correctly_surfaced_conflicts_denominator: Fixed planned denominator is 20 gold-conflict rows per arm; incomplete, malformed, misclassified, unsupported, or uncited conflict answers do not count as surfaced.
